about.title: About
about.about_app_subtitle: What DayFax is and who builds it
about.contact_intro: Reach the DayFax team for account, order, privacy, or safety questions. For a specific delivered order, open that order’s support chat when available.
about.order_support_hint: Order issues: open the order → Support. Account deletion: Profile → Delete account.
about.licenses_subtitle: Open-source packages used in this app
about.delete_account_subtitle: Request removal of your DayFax account
about.delete_account_intro: You can request deletion of your DayFax account by email. There is no fully automated in-app deletion yet.
about.delete_account_steps:
1. Email {email} from your registered phone or email.
2. Include “Account deletion request” and your registered phone number or Google email.
3. We verify ownership, then delete or anonymise data that is no longer required.
about.delete_account_retention: Some records may be kept where needed for pending orders, refunds, fraud prevention, disputes, or legal/accounting obligations.
